name: NGC 147 SD7 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 147 SD7, a globular cluster in the dwarf galaxy NGC 147, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc147sd7-hubble
story: SD7 is one of the outermost globular clusters of NGC 147, a dwarf elliptical companion of M31. Its stars are extremely poor in heavy elements, and their makeup points to an old age.

claims.text: NGC147-SD7 is a globular cluster target of Hubble program 15336, 'The Globular Cluster Systems of Local Group Dwarf Galaxies'
NGC 147 is a dwarf elliptical satellite of M31
SD7 is among the outermost globular clusters of NGC 147
SD7 is extremely metal-poor (its metallicity hits the floor of the study)
SD7's stars suggest an old age
The Hubble data are deep photometry of globular clusters in NGC 147, NGC 185 and NGC 6822
